J2.evidence: Arabic: كانوا يدخلون على النبى عليه السلام فى وقت الغَدَاء. الغداء is the meal of the early part of the day (from غُدوة, before noon), so TR 'sabah yemeği vaktinde' is a legitimate rendering (EN 'midday meal' is also within range); no error. Rest of TR checked: (أن) in رفع, لا يحل with yā', غير ناظرين nasb/khafd, A'shā verse, ولا مستأنسين, the sabab al-nuzūl incl. لئن مات محمد لأتزوجن (oath lam rendered 'vallahi') and لا جناح عليهن فى آبائهن are faithful.

J1.evidence: الغداء rendered 'sabah yemeği' is acceptable (الغَداء is the meal of the غُدوة, morning/forenoon), so the flagged point is not an error. But TR contains unmarked interpretive additions: 'فنُصبت على الفعل' rendered 'fiil üzere (hâl olarak) nasb edildi' — '(hâl olarak)' is not in the Arabic; 'ولو جعلت المستأنسين في موضع نصب تتوهم أن تتبعه بغير' rendered with an added apodosis '(bu da caiz olurdu)' that the Arabic lacks; also '(muhatapların)', '(değerinde)'. These must be marked as Mütercim notu.

J3.evidence: The flagged point itself is not an error: الغداء (فى وقت الغَدَاء) is the forenoon/first meal of the day, so 'sabah yemeği' is a defensible rendering. But the Turkish has unmarked explanatory additions, which glossary rule 9 forbids: (1) 'fiil üzere (hâl olarak) nasb edildi' for فنُصبت على الفعل: the reading 'hâl' is an interpretation that is not in the Arabic (the English correctly puts it in brackets as an explicit gloss); (2) 'kavmin (muhatapların) sıfatıdır' for نعت للقوم; (3) 'nasb mahallinde kılsaydın (bu da caiz olurdu)' supplies an apodosis that ولو جعلت المستأنسين فى موضع نصب ... does not state; (4) 'iki eli dolusu (değerinde)' for بملء يَدىْ. Fix: move these into «[Mütercim notu: …]» or remove them. The rest matches the Arabic.
